purpose: Repair two proof-carrying/acquisition defects exposed by R3A without rewriting R3A: (1) fallback SAT must carry a replayable witness; (2) acquisition must expose solver-native unit/restriction residuals across the frozen corpus instead of letting an early global cap starve families.

changes_allowed.proof_carrying_fallback: replace truth-only fallback result with exact witness-producing search while retaining independent frozen TRUMP DPLL verification
changes_allowed.acquisition_observer: record natural intermediate unit-propagation states and immediate post-restriction pre-unit states, then family-stratify selection

acquisition_freeze.source_roots: same existing frozen 24-case TRUMP direct-challenge corpus
acquisition_freeze.family_selection: round-robin by original frozen corpus family order

primary_gates.acquisition: at least 24 residuals and at least 4 source families
primary_gates.proof_carrying: all SAT candidates, including fallback modes, replay on the residual CNF
primary_gates.exactness: all candidate terminals match independent frozen TRUMP DPLL
primary_gates.pretruth: all route witnesses are sealed with truth=null before candidate/verifier execution
primary_gates.recurrence: at least one frozen structural signature recurs across distinct frozen roots

secondary_observation.work_metric: charged abstract ops versus frozen TRUMP DPLL work
secondary_observation.promotion: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY because R3B policy is informed by R3A implementation findings and may reuse structural neighborhoods
